description: Take back a question you asked, when it no longer needs answering — you worked it out, or the task moved on. The comment stays in the thread (the conversation happened) and the question stops counting on the other person's list. The person who asked, or anybody with full write access in the project.

questionId.description: The question's id, as returned by list_issue_questions or ask_issue_question.

name: withdraw_issue_question
